boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.body: {{appName}} hit an unexpected error. Your preferences and queued tags in local storage are usually unaffected.

oauth.firstLoadNote: First load downloads the game manifest and may take a minute.
oauth.noAuthCode: No authorization code returned: try signing in again.
oauth.stateMismatch: OAuth state mismatch: often caused by a stale tab or blocked session storage. Return to login and try again.
oauth.suffix: Try signing in again. If the problem persists, contact the site administrator.
oauth.devClientId: Client ID matches your Bungie application ({{clientId}})
oauth.devApiKey: API key is from the same Bungie application
oauth.devRestart: Restart the dev server after changing credentials

env.bungieSignInUnavailableDev: Sign-in is not enabled in this build.
env.bungieSignInUnavailable: Sign-in is not available on this deployment.
env.bungieCredentialsMissingDev: Bungie sign-in is not enabled in this environment.
env.bungieCredentialsMissing: Sign-in is not available on this deployment. Contact the site administrator.
env.bungieSecretMissingDev: Bungie sign-in is not fully enabled in this environment.
env.dimSyncUnavailableDev: DIM sync is not enabled in this environment.
env.dimSyncUnavailable: Applying tags to DIM is not available on this deployment. Contact the site administrator.

vault.sessionExpired: Your Bungie session may have expired. Sign out and sign in again.
vault.forbidden: Bungie rejected the request. Try signing in again, or contact the site administrator if this continues.
vault.manifest: Manifest download failed. Check your connection and retry: the first load can take a minute.
vault.network: Network error. Check your connection or try again in a moment.
vault.membership: Could not resolve your Destiny membership. Make sure the account has Destiny 2 characters.

partialApply: Applied {{ok}} of {{total}} tags. {{failed}} failed: retry or remove from queue.
